# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_RSI_BOUNCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a strong intraday impulse, a pullback to VWAP accompanied by a neutral RSI (40-60) offers a high-probability long entry for continuation. This edge exists because impulses often create temporary overextension, and a VWAP pullback with neutral momentum indicates the market is finding fair value before resuming the impulse direction, particularly in choppy to mildly trending regimes (VIX 14-22).

## Mechanism

Entry: Define impulse as >1% absolute price move over any 5-min window. After impulse ends, monitor 1-min bars; enter long at close when price crosses VWAP from below to above and 14-period RSI is between 40 and 60. Avoid first 15 min after open and last 15 min before close.  
Exit: Initial stop at most recent swing low prior to VWAP cross (chart-stop). Target 1: 1.5×R; if price reaches 1×R, move stop to break-even; allow runner to trail with 15% trailing distance from highest high since entry.
